For a skim, 40–60 minutes is enough for the introduction, method overview, main result figures, taxonomy section, and the MoE discussion. For a deeper read, two issues deserve extra attention: why early-layer matched-random controls become statistically weak, and how much of the observed mechanism divergence should be attributed to data, architecture, or optimization path. The paper does not fully disentangle those factors, but it sets up a useful framework for doing so.16b:T701,The method is a four-stage, model-driven pipeline. First, the target LLM predicts labels for the task examples, and those model predictions are used as the labels to be explained. This choice is deliberate: the goal is to explain the model’s own decision process, not ground-truth task structure. Second, the system performs differentiative concept extraction. It iteratively identifies human-readable concepts that distinguish the model-predicted classes, then maps each example into a concept vector describing the inferred state of each concept. The concepts are not pre-specified attributes; they are induced from the task through the model. Third, the paper introduces an MCMC-inspired counterfactual expansion procedure. Instead of generating isolated edits, it builds chains of counterfactual texts. Each step proposes a change targeting one concept while trying to keep the rest of the context stable, and a rejection mechanism filters out unfaithful candidates that alter too much beyond the intended intervention or break concept consistency. This is the most substantive part of the paper. It is inspired by proposal-and-accept/reject logic from MCMC, though it is better viewed as a structured counterfactual search procedure than a strict sampling algorithm. Fourth, causal discovery is run on the expanded concept dataset to recover a directed graph over concepts and the final prediction. The learned graph is meant to approximate the causal organization of the model’s inference process, not the causal structure of the external world. Compared with prior counterfactual explanation work, the key difference is the global graph objective. Compared with mechanistic interpretability, the target is not neurons or circuits but dependencies among human-interpretable concepts.16c:T50d,The evaluation uses three LLMs and three classification settings: sentiment analysis, disease diagnosis, and an LLM-as-a-judge classification task, spanning both natural and synthetic data. Since there is no ground-truth causal graph for the latent reasoning process, the paper evaluates two properties instead. The first is predictive fidelity: whether the discovered parent set of each node predicts that node better than alternative concept sets. The second is expansion utility: whether the counterfactual augmentation improves graph stability and accuracy relative to using only observed data. The reported findings are that the MCMC-style expansion yields more stable graph topology, and both the data distribution and graph structure show convergence behavior as the counterfactual chains grow. A notable qualitative result is the model-to-model contrast: on structured synthetic tasks, different LLMs converge to similar explanatory concepts, while on naturalistic tasks they develop distinct latent heuristics. That observation is useful for foundation-model analysis because similar task performance does not imply similar internal conceptual organization. The paper appears stronger on evaluation design and qualitative-plus-quantitative evidence than on headline benchmark numbers.16d:T6e5,The work has two parts: building PithTrain, a compact end-to-end MoE training framework, and introducing ATE-Bench, a benchmark for measuring how framework design affects coding-agent efficiency.

PithTrain is organized around four design principles. First, compactness: instead of broad production-style coverage, it deliberately narrows scope to a compact MoE training stack, around 11K lines of code. The point is not minimalism for its own sake, but reducing the search space and context burden for agents. Second, Python-native implementation: the framework minimizes dependence on deep C++/CUDA extension chains so that key logic remains easy to inspect and modify. Third, no implicit indirection: it avoids registry-heavy or plugin-heavy composition, making execution paths easier to infer from local reading. Fourth, task-specific agent skills: recurring framework tasks such as profiling, instrumentation, config edits, and log inspection are exposed as reusable skills so the agent does less blind exploration.

ATE-Bench flips the usual benchmark setup. Instead of fixing a codebase and comparing agents, it fixes the agent and varies the framework. Tasks are drawn from realistic training-framework work: code understanding Q&A, operating and profiling runs, and implementing new features. Metrics include not only completion but also Agent Turns, Output Tokens, and Active GPU Time, which better reflect real development cost.

Relative to existing frameworks, PithTrain is not trying to win on breadth. It chooses a different point on the trade-off curve: less generality, lower agent cost. That is distinct both from the standard “bigger, more complete framework” philosophy and from the separate line of making coding agents themselves stronger.16e:T654,The experiments aim to establish two claims: PithTrain does not fall far behind on training efficiency, and it materially improves agent-task efficiency.

On training throughput, the paper compares PithTrain against production frameworks on NVIDIA H100 and B200 across a range of MoE models and training settings. The reported conclusion is throughput parity on the tested configurations. That matters because the framework’s Python-native and compact design could have introduced a systems penalty; the paper argues that, at least for the chosen setups, it does not. Still, such parity is configuration-dependent and should not be overgeneralized to every production-scale regime.

On ATE-Bench, the results are more concrete. For the hardest new-feature tasks, using the same coding agent, PithTrain reduces Agent Turns by up to 62% and Active GPU Time by 64% relative to production frameworks, with similar reductions on other cost metrics such as output tokens. The interpretation is that agents get lost less often, read less irrelevant code, and close the edit-run-verify loop faster. The paper also includes a skills ablation and a qualitative case study, which suggest that the gains come not only from smaller code size but also from explicit skills and more direct execution structure.

From a research perspective, the most important thing to inspect is not the headline percentages but the benchmark design: whether the agent, prompts, and tool permissions are controlled; whether the tasks reflect real training-framework work; and whether throughput comparisons use matched kernels and parallel settings.16f:T54e,If you only want the main idea, start with Figure 1 and Table 1. Each lemma or theorem node contains a Lean type, the corresponding LaTeX statement, and natural-language proof content. Dependency links between nodes form a proof DAG. A key design choice is that this DAG is not frozen at initialization. It can be split, repaired, and reorganized during the run, which matches the uncertainty of research-level formalization much better than a static decomposition.

On top of this shared artifact, the system uses four contract-scoped agents responsible for construction, auditing, proving, and repair. The contract-scoped part matters. Agents are restricted to bounded edit regions rather than given unrestricted write access to the whole development. This is a deliberate error-containment mechanism: the worst outcome of a bad action should be a rejected patch, not hidden corruption of distant proof state.

Coordination is handled by a two-stage orchestrator. The first stage stabilizes target fidelity through adversarial review, trying to lock down whether the current formal statements still correspond to the intended mathematical targets. The second stage discharges the proof DAG from dynamic leaves upward in parallel, with each round gated by CI-style verification. This separation is important. The system does not ask one monolithic agent to simultaneously infer the structure, prove subgoals, debug failures, and decide whether it is still proving the right theorem.

The paper’s design principles are also worth noting: dynamic DAG decomposition, external or deterministic verification, restricted tool scope, and continuous projection between informal reasoning and the blueprint. Compared with monolithic ReAct-style agents, this is much closer to a controlled collaborative software workflow. Progress is determined by Lean and external auditors, not by the model’s self-assessment.172:T55b,From the provided full-text excerpt, the evaluation is centered on several Erdős problems drawn from two recent research papers, including #1051, #1196, #164, and #1217. In the experiments, prioritize case studies and failure analyses over the final type-check outcome alone. A 35 to 50 minute skim should be enough to understand the architecture. For deeper reading, three follow-up questions are worth pursuing: whether the blueprint can generalize to coding or research agents, whether contract-scoped editing suggests a better way to construct training traces, and whether verifier-driven loops can be turned into process-supervision signals for post-training.174:T5e2,The central object is a blueprint: a dependency graph whose nodes are formal definitions and lemmas, and whose edges encode proof dependencies leading to the target theorem. The pipeline has three stages. First, blueprint generation: given the target theorem statement, optionally with a natural-language proof, the architect model emits a Lean file containing formally stated intermediate nodes and declared dependencies. Second, node proving: a tool-using Lean prover attempts to close open lemma nodes, using the declared dependencies and retrieval over Mathlib. These node-level proof attempts can run in parallel, which is important because the graph exposes independent subproblems. Third, global refinement: failed nodes are not handled only by deeper local decomposition. Instead, failure information is sent back to the architect, which can rewrite the blueprint globally by changing intermediate lemmas, adding or removing definitions, or restructuring dependencies.

This differs from recursive decomposition pipelines, where an early bad split can trap the system in an unproductive subtree. It also differs from Draft-Sketch-Prove style approaches. There, the informal proof becomes a flat sketch with placeholders. Here, the optional natural-language proof is converted into a graph of named sublemmas, which is easier to revise and recombine. In system terms, the paper separates high-level strategy formation from low-level proof discharge, and uses the graph as the interface between them.175:T58e,The most notable result is the performance-cost tradeoff rather than a single benchmark number. The paper claims a new Pareto point for its compute class using the open-weight DeepSeek-V4-Flash backbone, with roughly $0.44 per problem, versus about $244 per problem for the next-best open pipeline reported in the comparison table. The introduction also positions the method against the broader landscape: open one-shot provers remain weak on Putnam-class problems, while systems above the 50% range typically depend on closed models, closed pipelines, or very high API spend.

The experiments to pay attention to are likely in three groups. First, benchmark results on MiniF2F, PutnamBench, and possibly newer Putnam-style sets, with separate comparisons against open one-shot provers, open agentic systems, and closed frontier pipelines. Second, ablations on the blueprint mechanism: whether global refinement helps over no refinement, whether graph-based planning beats recursive decomposition, and whether natural-language proof seeds improve difficult problems. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so precise solve-rate numbers should not be inferred beyond what the paper explicitly states in the introduction.176:T648,The framework has three parts. First, it formalizes a clique of Bernoulli questions linked by logical relations, and defines the coherent polytope as the set of marginal probability vectors realizable by some joint distribution consistent with those relations. Each component produces local empirical marginals from K samples, and local Joint-Coherent Decoding projects those marginals onto the local coherent polytope to remove within-component incoherence. Second, the paper proves a product-structure dichotomy. Under owner-selected aggregation, local coherence guarantees global coherence for all inputs if and only if the joint coherent polytope factorizes into a Cartesian product of local polytopes. Once tighter cross-component coupling exists, there are necessarily cases where every component is locally coherent but the composition is globally incoherent. The paper then derives a closed-form magnitude prediction for the residual in Rayleigh-quotient form, linked to specialist-panel covariance. Third, it provides runtime repair and testing. Given a composed quote and cross-component constraints, the system computes ε* by projecting onto the joint coherent polytope. A hierarchical Boyle-Dykstra projection deterministically repairs the quote by moving it back into the feasible set. An anytime-valid e-process gives a sequential test for coherence violations with false-positive control at arbitrary stopping times. Compared with ordinary calibration methods, the key difference is that this framework explicitly reasons over cross-component logical constraints rather than isolated outputs.177:T4e0,The empirical study uses 1,876 ensemble cliques drawn from Paleka and Polymarket, evaluated with four contemporary foundation models and stratified by four logical relation classes: partition, negation, disjunction, and conjunction. The observed hardness ordering is partition >> negation >> disjunction >> conjunction, matching the intuition that tighter joint constraints create larger room for compositional failure. The Rayleigh-quotient prediction matches the observed expected residual within 7% on three of the four relation classes. For conjunction, the prediction undershoots at 0.83x, which the authors argue is itself consistent with their interior-regime theory. The Dutch-book exposure upper bound, sqrt(m*) ε*, averages 0.137 under naive composition and is reduced to the quadratic-program solver floor after hierarchical projection. The paper also reports per-cell Brier scores with Diebold-Mariano significance testing, and includes same-model decoupling controls, leakage filtering, and a tool-augmented A/B setup to rule out simpler explanations. These are system-level probabilistic diagnostics rather than standard task-accuracy comparisons, so the right quantities to track are residuals, exposure bounds, and repair behavior.178:T66b,The authors introduce CoSee, an auditing framework for collaborative document VQA. It formalizes the interaction loop into a minimal action interface: read, write-to-board, and verify. The key object is the Board, a discrete and interpretable shared state. Each board entry contains a natural-language note, an optional grounding pointer such as page index or region coordinates, and the authoring agent ID. A lightweight controller enforces append-only updates, making the full reasoning trajectory observable and auditable.

Within this framework, the paper compares three inference protocols. The first is a direct single-turn baseline with no external state. The second is a single-agent board variant, where the model writes intermediate notes before answering. The third is a two-agent scanner-checker setup, where one agent scans and writes candidate evidence and another checks or answers based on the board. The authors keep prompts and decoding caps tightly matched across settings so that any difference is attributable to interaction dynamics rather than hidden compute advantages.

The main contribution is the diagnosis of failure mechanisms. The paper identifies two dominant modes. Noise Reinforcement happens when an ungrounded or incorrect note is written to the board and then repeatedly reused as evidence in later steps. Policy Collapse refers to drift in the model’s output behavior as context grows, for example toward overly short or under-covered answers. The proposed mitigation is lightweight verification, used as a minimal information bottleneck to prevent low-quality intermediate state from freely propagating.179:T587,Experiments are run on three document VQA distributions: SlideVQA, ChartQAPro, and VQAonline. The main backbone is Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, with scale and robustness checks on Qwen3-VL-8B, Phi-4, and Gemma-3-4B. The study compares single-turn answering, a single-agent board setup, and a two-agent collaborative setup, and evaluates them through cost-accuracy Pareto frontiers.

The empirical pattern is consistent. Naive shared memory gives at most marginal gains on retrieval-heavy tasks and often hurts reasoning-heavy tasks relative to the single-turn baseline. Multi-agent collaboration frequently underperforms because of coordination overhead and coverage failures. More tokens do not automatically buy more accuracy; under weak quality control, higher cost often correlates with worse performance. Trace-grounded analysis shows that chart reasoning is especially vulnerable to noise reinforcement, while open-ended QA is more prone to policy collapse, often visible as short-answer drift. Adding lightweight verification reduces error propagation, suggesting that the main issue is not just model size but the absence of a grounded information bottleneck.

The provided excerpt does not include full numeric tables, so the safe takeaway is about the regime and the mechanism: 4B to 8B models, single-GPU constraints, tightly controlled inference budgets, and collaboration failure driven by noisy shared state.17a:T4d3,JAMEL formulates exploration as a POMDP with an intrinsic novelty objective.
- Latent memory construction: each step’s (observation, action) is serialized into an input x_i and passed through a frozen vision-language model F_φ; the EOS hidden state becomes a single latent “memory token” for that step. The history becomes a sequence of such tokens.
- Memory injection: a learned linear aligner W projects memory tokens into the policy LM embedding space; the projected tokens are prepended as a prefix to condition action generation.
- Supervision via novelty: define a binary novelty reward indicating whether the current step discovers behavior not covered by the agent’s own history. In GUIs, novelty is instantiated via deterministic code coverage signals.
- Training pipeline: collect interaction data and apply rejection fine-tuning to bias learning toward trajectories/actions that yield higher novelty, thereby jointly improving exploration and making the latent memory useful.

Design trade-off: freezing the compressor improves stability and reduces training burden, but limits adaptivity; novelty-driven training is used to force the policy to encode and exploit “what has been tried” in the compressed tokens.17b:T421,The evaluation uses three benchmarks. AutoDCWorkflow contains 142 workflow-generation tasks and measures factual consistency as well as cell-level accuracy after deterministic execution. MMTU contributes a 200-question sample across error detection, data imputation, entity matching, and schema matching. MaTElDa provides 100 real-world tables with injected errors for cell-level precision, recall, and F1. The study covers more than 6,000 task-condition pairs and four model families. Standard debate hurts workflow generation across all four models, with drops from about 1.6 to 15.5 percentage points. For error detection, debate improves F1 by about 27.4 points, with effect size d=1.0. A 6-by-3 critic/generator prompt sweep shows that the confusion effect is not a prompt artifact. Self-verification and self-consistency voting do not fix the problem. Code-execution grounding removes much of the confusion, and evidence-gated generation is the first debate variant reported to beat the single-agent workflow baseline, by about 5.3 points with p<0.05.17c:T934,方法很克制，核心是一个单遍的 trace induction pipeline。输入是一批训练集上的 ReAct rollouts，每条 rollout 由 Thought / Action / Observation 序列组成。作者只从成功轨迹里抽取每一步 Thought 文本，把它们视为 reasoning move 的外显表达，然后做三件事。

第一步是按 step-level thought 做聚类，目标不是恢复完整 workflow，而是找到跨样本重复出现的局部 reasoning move。这里的设计选择很关键：作者刻意不诱导完整程序或任务图，而只诱导 finer-grained primitives，因为完整流程往往过拟合任务模板，而 reasoning move 更容易跨实例复用。

第二步是 primitive synthesis。对每个高频簇，系统拿到一个簇标签和若干代表性 thoughts，让 LLM 写出一个 primitive 规范，形式是三元组 p=(name, signature, docstring)。其中 signature 不是自动学出来的，而是由 task-family prompt 预先给定，例如输入 narrative 和 focus，输出字符串。这种设计把“调用接口约束”和“具体语义说明”拆开：signature 负责约束 agent 如何调用，docstring 负责描述这个 reasoning move 要完成什么。作者强调这点是为了避免必须手写可执行逻辑，因为很多 reasoning 操作没有干净的 deterministic Python 实现。

第三步是 deployment。诱导出的 primitive 被注册成 pseudo-tools，工具体本身没有手写逻辑；调用时，把 docstring 和运行时参数拼成 prompt 交给 LLM，解析输出后返回给 agent。测试时，agent 的 action space 只有这些 induced primitives 加一个 finish，除此之外没有原始搜索/查找工具，也不把 primitive 描述直接塞进 system prompt。也就是说，提升来自“把 reasoning move 变成可调用动作”，而不是简单给模型更多提示词。

论文反复强调一个机制解释：源 ReAct agent 在实例级别临时生成 thought，方差很大；而 induction 在语料级别聚合成功轨迹，把同类 move 写成稳定规范。测试时调用的是这个规范，而不是要求模型再次从零生成同样的 move，因此 induced library 可能超过 source policy。这一点把它和普通 trace distillation 区分开了：这里不是复述原轨迹，而是把轨迹里不稳定但反复出现的结构抽出来。17d:T7d2,The method is a lightweight single-pass induction pipeline over successful ReAct trajectories. Each rollout contains interleaved Thought, Action, and Observation steps. The system extracts step-level Thought strings from successful traces and treats them as noisy surface realizations of latent reasoning moves.

It then clusters these thoughts to identify recurring local moves. This design choice is deliberate: the goal is not to induce a full workflow or task graph, which would be more brittle and task-template-specific, but a reusable vocabulary of reasoning operations.

For each frequent cluster, the pipeline synthesizes a primitive represented as p = (name, signature, docstring). The signature is fixed by a task-family prompt rather than learned from scratch; it constrains how the agent calls the primitive and what output type it should expect. The docstring carries the semantic content of the reasoning move. This separation is important because many reasoning operations do not have a clean deterministic implementation, so the paper instantiates primitives as pseudo-tools rather than handwritten tools.

At runtime, invoking a primitive means formatting the docstring together with the runtime arguments into an LLM prompt, parsing the response into the declared output type, and returning it to the agent. During deployment, the action space contains only the induced primitive library plus a finish action. The original generic tools are removed, and primitive descriptions are not copied into the system prompt. This makes the evaluation closer to action-space restructuring than prompt engineering.

The paper’s main mechanism claim is that induction performs corpus-level aggregation over successful traces, while the source ReAct agent makes instance-level decisions with high variance. A synthesized primitive acts as a stable specification of a reasoning move, so calling it at test time is not equivalent to asking the original agent to rediscover that move from scratch.17e:T693,The evaluation covers reasoning-heavy task families including RuleArena NBA, MuSR team allocation, and NatPlan meeting planning. The headline result is that induced primitive libraries outperform the very ReAct agent that generated the traces: RuleArena NBA improves from 30 to 74 (+44 points), MuSR team allocation from 38 to 68 (+30), and NatPlan meeting planning from 7 to 29 (+22). The paper reports paired-delta confidence intervals, all strictly positive.

A second important comparison is against expert-authored decompositions. The induced libraries beat expert designs by 17 points on MuSR team allocation and 15 points on NatPlan meeting planning, while roughly matching them on the remaining comparable subtasks. That is a stronger result than merely showing gains over a weak baseline.

The supervision setup is intentionally minimal. The source agent only has generic search/lookup tools, with no benchmark-specific action vocabulary and no domain-specific handcrafted tools. The induced structure is therefore recovered post hoc from generic-agent traces.

The deployment ablations matter. The canonical setup keeps only induced primitives plus finish, and does not inject primitive descriptions into the system prompt. This helps rule out the simpler explanation that the gains come from extra prompt instructions rather than from a better structured action space.

The full paper also notes that the pipeline uses only two free parameters, K and m, plus three LLM prompts, with one fixed configuration across benchmarks. That supports portability, though it also makes clear that this is a lightweight post hoc framework rather than a new large-scale training recipe.17f:T415,Start with the introduction, especially the distinction between reasoning primitives, workflows, and executable skills. That framing determines what the method is and is not trying to recover.

Then read the method section carefully, focusing on the primitive representation: name, signature, and docstring. The key design question is why the paper uses typed pseudo-tools with LLM-interpreted docstrings instead of executable implementations.

After that, go straight to the main results and the comparison with expert-authored decompositions. The central phenomenon to assess is the source-exceeding result: why can a library induced from an agent’s traces outperform the source agent itself? The paper’s answer is variance reduction through corpus-level aggregation, and that is the part most worth thinking about.

A 20–30 minute skim is enough for the main idea. If time permits, check the deployment ablations and confidence-interval details in the appendix to verify that the gains are not mostly prompt leakage or evaluation noise.180:Tb02,方法由三部分组成，而且三部分是互相咬合的，而不是简单拼装。

第一部分是 live MCP environments。作者实现了 20 个 stateful MCP server，共 343 个工具，每个环境作为独立子进程运行，通过 stdio 通信，并且在 rollout 级别做 session-scoped state isolation。这个设计的关键不是“工具多”，而是“每个 rollout 的状态独立且可重置”，否则 RL 训练会被跨样本污染。环境覆盖 finance、calendar、filesystem、commerce、travel、IoT、developer tools 等场景，强调的是账户余额、库存、日历事件、文件树这类会随调用改变的状态。相比 cached API，live execution 能暴露余额不足、优惠券过期、实体不存在、前置步骤未完成等错误，这些恰好是多步 tool use 最容易出问题的地方。

第二部分是 grounded state-machine data synthesis。作者没有直接让 LLM 凭空写 query，而是先 probe live server，采样当前真实实体和状态，再基于 dependency graph 和状态机驱动 teacher 生成多轮对话。这里的关键点有两个：一是 query grounding，保证提到的账户、订单、事件、文件等在当前环境里真的存在；二是 replay validation，所有轨迹都要重新执行验证。生成的数据不仅包含标准多步工具调用，还包含 missing-function clarification 和 abstention 场景，也就是工具不够、信息不足、应该追问或拒绝时的行为。全文强调这套数据构造不依赖人工标注，也不依赖 LLM-as-judge，而是靠程序执行结果闭环验证。

第三部分是 multi-component programmatic reward。奖励被拆成五项：tool call validity、dependency-ordered coverage、adaptive efficiency penalty、tool-name signal、argument-value matching bonus。这里最重要的是后两项设计思路。dependency-ordered coverage 不只看是否覆盖 GT 调用，还看顺序是否满足依赖关系，避免模型“把对的工具都调一遍”却不按执行逻辑组织。adaptive efficiency penalty 则不是固定惩罚调用次数，而是按任务复杂度给一个 call budget，超过预算再罚，避免简单任务和复杂任务用同一尺子。tool-name signal 给模型一个更直接的工具选择监督；argument-value matching 则把参数填充质量纳入奖励，而不是只看工具名是否对。作者在消融里指出，adaptive budget 和 tool-name signal 是最关键的两个组件，这说明冗长调用和错误选工具是 RL tool use 中两个最主要的失真源。

训练上，系统接入 VERL 框架，把模型生成的 tool call 路由到 MCP server 执行，再把执行结果和程序化 reward 回传。论文更像是在做“可执行环境上的 RL recipe”，而不是提出新的 RL 算法。181:Tb03,The method has three tightly coupled components.

First, live MCP environments. The authors build a library of 20 stateful MCP servers exposing 343 tools. Each environment runs as an isolated subprocess and communicates over stdio. During RL, every rollout gets a unique session ID, which enforces session-scoped state isolation. This is more important than the raw tool count: without per-rollout isolation, state contamination across episodes would corrupt both reward and learning. The environments cover domains such as finance, productivity, commerce, travel, IoT, developer tools, and knowledge management. Their defining property is statefulness: balances change, events persist, files accumulate edits, and so on. Compared with cached APIs, live execution exposes realistic failures such as insufficient balance, expired coupons, missing entities, or unmet prerequisites.

Second, grounded state-machine data synthesis. Instead of prompting an LLM to invent tasks from scratch, the pipeline first probes each live server to sample real entities and current state. Query generation is then grounded in those sampled entities, and a state-machine teacher generates multi-turn conversations following tool dependency graphs. Every generated trace is replayed and validated. This matters for two reasons: the queries refer to entities that actually exist in the environment, and the final trajectories are execution-valid rather than merely plausible in text form. The synthesized set includes not only standard multi-step tool-use traces, but also clarification turns for missing information and abstention cases where no tool should be used.

Third, a fully programmatic multi-component reward. The reward decomposes tool-use quality into five parts: tool-call validity, dependency-ordered coverage, an adaptive efficiency penalty with a complexity-scaled call budget, a tool-name signal, and an argument-value matching bonus. The design choice that matters most is that coverage is not enough; the model must cover the right calls in the right dependency order. The adaptive efficiency term is also important: instead of penalizing all extra calls equally, the budget scales with task complexity, which avoids over-penalizing genuinely complex tasks. The tool-name signal gives direct supervision on tool selection, while argument-value matching rewards correct parameter filling. The ablation identifies the adaptive budget and tool-name signal as the most critical components, suggesting that verbosity and wrong tool choice are the main distortions induced by naive RL rewards.

Training is implemented in VERL, with model-generated tool calls routed to the MCP servers and rewards computed from execution outcomes. The paper is best read as an executable-environment RL recipe rather than a new RL algorithm.182:T713,The main empirical result is straightforward: Prove improves all four tested models, from two architecture families, on all three benchmarks—BFCL Multi-Turn, τ²-bench, and T-Eval—using only about 13K training examples. The paper also emphasizes that this is roughly 8× smaller than a concurrent RL pipeline such as AgenticQwen, and it does not rely on an external judge model. From the available full text, three experimental messages matter most.

First, the gains are consistent across models and benchmarks. That reduces the chance that the method is overfitting to one benchmark’s annotation style or one model family’s tool-calling format.

Second, the reward ablation is highly informative. The adaptive call budget and the tool-name signal are reported as the most load-bearing components. This supports the paper’s diagnosis that recall-style rewards fail not because they are weak, but because they point in the wrong direction: if extra calls are not penalized and correct tool choice is not directly rewarded, the model can improve reward by becoming verbose.

Third, the environment and synthesis pipeline appear to matter because they improve execution validity rather than textual plausibility. The paper repeatedly contrasts live MCP execution with cached or simulated APIs, and grounded synthesis with ungrounded synthetic queries. Even without exhaustive numerical detail in the excerpt, the mechanism is clear: fewer samples can still be effective if each sample is aligned with real environment state and validated by execution.

The key scale numbers are already useful: 20 MCP servers, 343 tools, around 13K training examples, 4 models, and 3 benchmarks. The overall picture is that the gains come from better reward and environment fidelity, not from brute-force data scaling.183:T57b,This is a skim paper, so the goal is to extract the training recipe rather than every implementation detail. Start with the Introduction and focus on the three gaps the paper identifies: no live stateful execution, synthetic queries detached from actual server state, and recall-based rewards that encourage verbosity. Then jump to Method §3.1 and §3.3. In §3.1, pay attention to session-scoped state isolation; it is an easy detail to miss, but it is central if RL is run against mutable environments. In §3.3, focus on the reward decomposition, especially dependency-ordered coverage and the adaptive efficiency penalty. Those are the pieces that distinguish “solve the task” from “call many tools.”

If time is limited, prioritize the main results table and the reward ablation. The main table tells you whether the method is stable across models; the ablation tells you which design choices actually matter. The environment catalog and synthesis details can be read quickly—the important part is the pipeline structure: probe state, generate grounded queries, execute, and replay-validate.

Expected reading time is about 25–35 minutes. Two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether this style of programmatic reward can scale to more open-ended web or desktop agents, and whether grounded synthesis can also be used to build higher-quality post-training data beyond RL.184:T729,The method centers on a skill compiler, a hypernetwork G_phi that takes a skill document s and outputs LoRA updates for selected modules of a frozen backbone LLM. At inference time, the generated adapter is mounted onto the model, and the agent conditions only on the task history rather than re-inserting the skill text into the prompt.

Training has two stages. First, document-level pretraining initializes the compiler on a corpus of skill documents. Two self-supervised tasks are used. In reconstruction, the compiler reads the full skill document and the adapted backbone is trained to reproduce it under a reconstruction instruction. In completion, the compiler reads a truncated prefix and the adapted backbone is trained to complete the full document. The point is not document generation per se, but learning a stable mapping from procedural text to useful parameter updates.

Second, trajectory-supervised fine-tuning aligns the generated latent skills with actual downstream behavior in agent trajectories. The backbone remains frozen, while the compiler is updated so that the generated LoRA affects action generation in the intended way. This differs from ordinary SFT: the skill is constrained to live in adapter space, preserving modular loading, unloading, replacement, scaling, and potential composition.

The paper also studies three properties of the generated adapters. They are structured, in that skills from different domains cluster in weight space. They are controllable, since the LoRA scaling coefficient alpha smoothly modulates the skill effect. They are composable, but only when the original skills are decomposed into semantically aligned components before combining their adapters. That last point is important: composition is conditional on the granularity and alignment of the skill decomposition.185:T567,The main evaluations are on ALFWorld and Search-QA. Against the corresponding in-context skill baseline, LatentSkill improves ALFWorld success by 21.4 points on the seen split and 13.4 points on the unseen split, while reducing prefill tokens by 64.1%. The abstract truncates the Search-QA numbers, but the full paper reports the same qualitative pattern: better task performance with substantially less prompt overhead from skill text.

The analysis experiments are more informative than the headline numbers. Weight-space visualizations show domain-level clustering of generated skill adapters, suggesting that the compiler learns structured procedural representations rather than a trivial prompt compression. Alpha-scaling experiments show smooth control over skill strength. Composition experiments show that adapter combination works best when skills are decomposed into aligned subskills; coarse or entangled skills compose less reliably. This defines the method’s boundary: it is better viewed as compiling modular procedural knowledge than as a universal replacement for arbitrary natural-language instructions.

From a systems perspective, the gains should be largest in long-horizon agent settings where the same skill text would otherwise be reinserted many times. The advantage is likely smaller when interactions are short or the skill descriptions are already brief.186:T406,Start with the introduction and the opening of the method section. The key setup is the trilemma among context cost, plaintext exposure, and loss of modularity under full parameterization. Then focus on the two-stage training design: document-level pretraining and trajectory-supervised fine-tuning. That is where the paper’s main idea lives.

In the experiments, prioritize three parts. First, the ALFWorld and Search-QA main tables to understand the performance-versus-token-cost trade-off. Second, the weight-space clustering or visualization results, which test whether latent skills have meaningful structure. Third, the alpha-control and skill-composition ablations, since they reveal whether the generated adapters are actually usable as modular artifacts.

A useful reading question is why reconstruction/completion pretraining transfers to action-level behavior at all. Another is the capacity limit of the hypernetwork: how well this scales when the skill library becomes larger, more heterogeneous, or more student scorer，用于全量语料推理。第四步做 source-conditioned reliability aggregation：对不同维度估计可靠性，屏蔽不稳定维度，再用 source-aware retention threshold 做选择，而不是用一个全局 cutoff。与传统 perplexity/filtering 的区别是它显式定义了源内语义质量；与普通 LLM-as-judge 的区别是它不依赖固定全局 rubric，也不在全量数据上直接调用大 teacher。","experiments":"实验选择 code-oriented mid-training，因为代码能力数据天然异构，包含代码文档、代码生成问答、agent/tool-use 记录等。数据侧覆盖 21 个 sources 和 5 个 source groups。MIRA 使用超过 200 万条 teacher-scored records 进行 rubric discovery 和 distillation，再把学生打分器应用到数千万条记录。训练比较使用 50B-token 级别 baselines，并在 9 个 benchmark 上聚合评估。结果显示，group-level MIRA 优于强 50B-token 基线；在只使用约一半 token addresses data selection for mid-training, where the objective remains pretraining-like and large-scale, but the corpus is capability-oriented and highly heterogeneous. A single perplexity score, influence signal, or global quality rubric is not enough for mixtures that combine web/code/math documents, instruction examples, reasoning traces, tool-use logs, and multi-turn agent trajectories.","importance":"The paper is important for pretraining-oriented work because it treats mid-training data curation as its own problem, rather than as ordinary pretraining filtering or post-training judging. This is a practical path for bringing LLM-judge supervision into near-pretraining-scale selection without paying teacher inference cost on the full corpus or forcing all sources into one global rubric.","technical_approach":"MIRA separates rubric discovery from scalable scoring. It first groups related sources using content-embedding similarity, so that each group has more consistent capability roles and quality patterns. It then performs self-anchored rubric discovery: a frontier teacher inspects sampled records and freely articulates quality dimensions; these dimension-level judgments are clustered into group-specific anchor rubrics. The anchors are used to obtain structured teacher labels, which are distilled into group-specific lightweight student scorers. Finally, MIRA aggregates scores with source-conditioned reliability estimates, masks unreliable dimensions, and applies source-aware retention thresholds instead of a single global cutoff. Compared with model-based pretraining filters, it exposes the semantic criteria behind quality. Compared with standard LLM-as-judge filtering, it avoids fixed rubrics and makes scoring feasible at corpus scale.","experiments":"The empirical setting is code-oriented mid-training, chosen because code data mixes documents, code-generation QA, and agent/tool-use records. The group-level variant outperforms the 50B-token baselines and slightly exceeds the unfiltered full-corpus run while using roughly half as many tokens. likelihood 之外，representation geometry 可能需要被显式纳入训练目标；二是浅层与深层表示分工可以被利用为自监督信号，而不只是做 probing；三是未来很多关于 any-order LM、masked LM、diffusion LM 的比较，不应只看 perplexity 或下游分数，也要看训练目标如何塑造内部几何。","technical_approach":"方法本身并不复杂，但设计点比较讲究。标准自回归模型在位置 t 产生最后层隐藏状态 h_t，用它预测 x_{t+1}。NITP 在这个基础上增加一个辅助目标：让 h_t 去预测“下一个 token 的隐式表示”。这个隐式表示不是词表 embedding，也不是外部模型编码，而是同一模型在处理位置 t+1 时某个浅层层数的隐藏状态 z_{t+1}^{(l)}，并且对该目标 stop-gradient，避免目标分支与预测分支相互追逐导致塌缩。训练时联合优化 NTP 的交叉熵和一个表示相似性损失，文中采用 cosine similarity 形式，使 h_t 在语义方向上靠近这个浅层目标。\n\n这里有几个关键选择。第一，为什么用浅层表示，而不是最后层表示做 bootstrap target。作者的论证是，浅层更保留词汇和局部语义信息，尚未被深层任务特化所压缩；如果直接用深层表示当目标，容易把已经退化或过度任务化的表征再复制一遍，监督增益有限。第二，为什么预测的是 t+1 位置的表示，而不是当前 token 的重构。因为目标仍然要与 next-token 预测对齐，保持自回归训练的时间因果结构。第三，为什么用连续目标而不是离散 label smoothing 一类办法。作者认为 one-hot 或其轻微平滑版本仍主要作用在输出空间，不能直接约束隐藏状态的几何。NITP 则把监督信号直接落在 representation space。\n\n论文还给了一个理论化解释：在 NTP 下，梯度主要由目标 token 及少数高概率竞争项主导，因此 h_t 的更新主要沿着目标 embedding 相关方向发生，而在大规模正交子空间中损失近似不变。这会形成一个平坦但欠约束的优化景观，允许大量几何上很差的表示与相同 token likelihood 共存。NITP 通过增加一个稠密的向量级约束，缩小了这部分自由度，相当于给隐藏状态增加了额外的几何锚点。实现上它几乎不需要额外前向，因为浅层表示本来就在同一次 forward 中产生，额外成本主要是一个相似度损失和少量投影/对齐计算，因此作者把它定位为低开销的 objective augmentation。","experiments":"从给出的全文内容看，实验主线很清楚，重点不是刷很多 benchmark，而是验证“几何退化是否存在、NITP 是否真的缓解、缓解后是否转化为能力收益”。第一类实验是训练动态分析。作者持续跟踪最后层隐藏状态的 Effective High-curvature directions are treated as sharp directions where gradient noise can destabilize optimization. Low-curvature directions are treated as flat valley directions where coherent descent should be preserved. The method estimates the Hessian spectrum on a validation set, decomposes the space into sharp and flat components, and scores each training example by how its gradient projects onto these components. Good samples should contribute descent along flat directions while suppressing perturbations along sharp directions. The selection problem is formulated with directional constraints, and a Successive Convex Approximation solver is used for the non-convex alignment constraints. To make the method feasible, the paper uses randomized sketching to approximate high-dimensional gradient projections. The resulting data schedule can be precomputed with a single pass over the dataset before annealing.","experiments":"The paper reports experiments across multiple architectures and scales, and claims consistent gains over empirical annealing baselines such as domain upsampling and long-context data scheduling. Existing FP8, FP4, activation-quantization, and compressed-state recipes often treat precision as a mostly static configuration or an offline calibration choice. The hard part of low-precision training is not only average quantization error; it is whether rare local perturbations trigger loss spikes, gradient anomalies, or lasting quality degradation. GNMR reframes low-precision stability as closed-loop control: monitor local risk at every step, recover only a sparse subset of risky operators, and enforce an explicit budget. To detect abrupt short-term changes, the paper adds Δ-GNMR, which normalizes the signal by a recent window and emphasizes deviations from near-term behavior. The controller then ranks eligible units by risk, recovers only the top-risk subset, limits instantaneous overhead with maxO, and uses a short Tlock interval to prevent rapid switching. Selected units are routed through a higher-fidelity recovery path, while the rest continue on the low-cost path. Surprisingly, no previous work has exploited the curvature constraints that arise from well known weight-space symmetries in loss landscapes. By analytically averaging over group actions that leave the loss invariant, we construct structured Hessian approximations from single gradients that can be tractably estimated, stored, and inverted. Hessian 太大、太贵、太难估；现有近似方法如 KFAC、Shampoo、Muon 往往是从矩阵结构或数值可行性出发设计，而不是从神经网络损失天然存在的权重空间对称性出发。作者要解决的是：能不能只用一次梯度计算，就借助这些对称群诱导出的约束，构造出可存储、可求逆、可用于优化的结构化 Hessian 结构联系起来，说明近似 Hessian 必然落在对应群的 commutant algebra 中，因此天然是低维、结构化、可压缩的。第二层是方法层：它把 Shampoo/Muon 这类看似经验上成功的预条件器，解释成某类置换子群下的特例。这对做大模型优化的人有价值，因为它把很多分散的二阶近似方法放进了同一个设计空间：你不是只能在已有优化器里选，而是可以通过选择对称群来调节近似精度、计算量和稳定性。对预训练而言，这更像是一个“优化器设计语言”的扩展，而不是单点技巧。","technical_approach":"方法核心是群平均。设损失在某个参数变换群 G 下不变，那么梯度在群作用下满足等变性。作者利用这一点，从单个参数点的一个梯度出发，解析地得到该点沿群轨道上梯度变化的平均结构，再把这种变化解释为局部曲率的近似信号。形式上，得到的 Hessian 近似是对梯度外积或相关量在群作用下做 orbit average，结果一定属于该群表示的交换子代数，也就是 commutant algebra。这个结论很关键，因为它直接给出近似矩阵的参数化方式：不需要存完整矩阵，只需要存若干基元素的系数。\n\n作者进一步把这个框架落到具体网络上。对 MLP 和 Transformer，他们分析不同对称群选择下 commutant 的维度，从而得到复杂度—表达力的权衡。群越大，约束越强，代数维度越低，计算和存储越便宜；但群轨道也更“远”，平均后的梯度变化更像全局几何，未必忠实反映局部 Hessian。群越小，近似更局部、更细，但代价更高。这一点不是泛泛而谈，作者明确把它作为方法设计旋钮。\n\n工程上，作者提供了一个 just-in-time 编译器：用户用符号方式指定对称性，系统自动生成对应的 PyTorch 例程来计算这些低维因子。这意味着框架不是纯理论，而是试图把“指定群—生成曲率近似—用于预条件更新”做成可操作流程。\n\n另一个重要点是与现有方法的关系。作者证明，特定的置换子群选择会导出与 Shampoo/Muon 同构或等价的曲率结构。这不是简单类比，而是把这些优化器解释为“在某个群下做受约束的 Hessian 为什么在 LLM pretrain 中有效，都有直接启发。贡献量级上，它更像是对 Muon 机制的关键补全，而不是提出全新优化器。","technical_approach":"技术路线分成理论建模、顺序比较、以及与预训练现象对齐三部分。理论上，作者采用 structured signal-plus-perturbation 的梯度模型，把每步梯度写成持续存在的低秩 coherent signal 加上均值为零、方差有界、并与信号正交的扰动项。这个设定的关键不是追求最一般，而是刻画预训练中常见的情形：有一部分跨 step 稳定存在的方向，对应可积累的学习信号；同时有高频、各向分散的噪声。\n\n在这个模型下，作者分析三条 pipeline：标准 Muon 的 pre-polar，即先形成 momentum buffer M_t=βM_{t-1}+(1-β)G_t，再取 polar factor O(M_t)；Orthogonal-SGDM 风格的 post-polar，即先对每步梯度做 O(G_t) 再做 momentum；以及不带 momentum 的 polar-only。核心结论有两步。第一步，momentum 对原始梯度流起到谱低通滤波作用。由于 coherent signal 在时间上持续，动量累积会保留并放大这部分结构；而均值为零的扰动会在时间平均中被压制。结果是第 r 和 r+1 个奇异值之间的 gap 随有效窗口增大而拉开，top-r 奇异子空间更稳定。作者用定理和推论把这种“谱间隔扩大—子空间更可靠”的链条形式化。第二步，polar update 的性质决定了它只能保留奇异向量方向，不能保留奇异值大小。一旦对 noisy gradient 直接做 polar，信号与噪声在幅度上的差异被抹掉，后面再做 momentum 只能在已经失真的方向上平滑，无法重新建立谱分离。因此 pre-polar 优于 post-polar 不是经验巧合，而是由非交换性和信息保真顺序决定的。\n\n论文还给出定量分离结果：在固定信号矩阵下，pre-polar 的更新方向与真实信号子空间更接近，post-polar 和 polar-only The student model has fixed random ReLU features and only trains the top-layer coefficients, making the problem a linear regression with a controlled feature matrix. Five optimizer variants are implemented as gradient preconditioners: plain GD with identity preconditioning; a diagonal preconditioner as an AdamW proxy; full natural gradient using the inverse feature Gram matrix as an idealized Shampoo/K-FAC proxy; Sign-GD; and a matrix-sign or inverse-square-root Gram preconditioner as a Muon proxy. 来控制激进程度。作者指出，这个粒度可能过细。实际去噪过程中，可靠预测常常不是孤立 token，而是连续出现的高置信 span；如果仍按 token 一个个提交，会浪费迭代步数，也会限制 MDLM 的并行潜力。于是论文把问题改写为：能否把连续高置信 span 作为并行提交单位，同时避免同一步里提交彼此仍强依赖、会产生联合不一致的 cluster。这里的设计很直接，但背后假设很明确：连续高置信位置往往共享局部上下文支持，适合作为一个整体提交。第二步，估计 cluster 之间的依赖冲突。作者不重新训练额外模块，而是复用同一次前向传播里的 self-attention map，把 token 间依赖聚合到 cluster 间，得到 inter-cluster dependency score。然后只保留“互为 strongest dependency”的边，构成一个较稀疏的 conflict graph。这个 mutual strongest 过滤很关键，因为如果把所有弱依赖都连边，图会过密，最后退化成过保守解码。第三步，在 conflict graph 上做 maximum-weight non-conflicting cluster selection，也就是选一组彼此不冲突、总权重最大的 CIC 并行提交。权重来自 cluster 的置信度或其聚合形式。这样做相当于把每一步的提交决策写成一个受依赖约束的组合优化问题，而不是独立 token 排序。与 DAPD、DAWN 这类 token-level dependency-aware 方法相比，CLAD 的区别不只是把 attention 用到 cluster 上，更重要的是它把“局部可靠性”和“全局兼容性”拆成两个层次：先定义 span 写成两部分：一部分是输入到当前输出的直接单跳影响，另一部分是过去输出经递推传播到当前的多跳影响。在这个框架下，关键问题就变成：递推阶数、矩阵结构和稀疏模式如何决定可表达的依赖范围，以及它们分别要付出多少计算和 cache 代价。","importance":"对预训练研究的意义主要不在于立刻替代 Transformer，而在于它把“token mixer 设计空间”整理得更清楚了。对于做基座模型的人，这类工作有两个实际价值。第一，它提供了一个统一语言去比较 attention、SSM、hybrid mixer 和更高阶 recurrence，不再只看经验曲线，而是能从 A/B 矩阵结构、递推阶数和求解方式来理解差异。第二，它把一个常被忽略的维度——higher-order recurrence——重新带回到序列建模里，并明确展示了从 O(n) 到 recurrence。作者把每个位置的输出 y_i 写成两类项的和：一类来自过去输入 x_j 的线性组合，系数记为 α_{i,j}；另一类来自过去输出 y_j 的线性组合，系数记为 β_{i,j}。写成矩阵形式就是 Y = AX + BY，因此 Y = (I-B)^{-1}AX，其中 A 是下三角，B 是严格下三角。这个形式有几个关键点。\n\n第一，attention 是 B=0 的特例，此时只有直接输入影响，没有显式输出递推；SSM/RNN 则对应 B 具有特定带状或子对角结构，同时 A 也有受限结构。这样一来，不同 mixer 的差异被还原成 A 和 B 的结构差异，而不是表面上的实现差异。\n\n第二，作者强调“递推阶数”是独立设计轴。传统 RNN/很多 SSM 只依赖前一个状态，相当于一阶递推；这里允许 y_i 依赖多个过去输出，也就是 higher-order recurrence。这样做的动机很直接：如果只靠一阶状态压缩全部历史，表达能力受限；允许多阶依赖后，可以在不回到全量 attention 的情况下扩大有效记忆和交互模式。\n\n第三，作者通过给 A/B 施加结构约束，构造出不同复杂度的 mixer。文中讨论了从线性复杂度到近线性、再到次二次和二次复杂度的若干模式。直观上，越稀疏、越局部、越低阶的 B，推理时 cache 和更新越便宜；越高阶、越稠密或越全局的结构，表达能力越强，但求解和存储成本上升。论文的价值在于把这些 trade-off 显式化。\n\n第四，框架不仅是递推视角，也兼容并行求解视角。因为 Y = (I-B)^{-1}AX，可以考虑利用矩阵结构做更快的并行 solver，而不是只能逐 token 递推。这一点对训练阶段尤其重要：很多 recurrence 类模型推理便宜，但训练并行性差；作者试图说明，若 B 有合适结构，训练也未必必须退回纯串行。\n\n从与现有方法的区别看，这篇工作不是提出某个单独新模块，而是把 attention、linear attention、SSM、hybrid mixer 放进同一代数框架，再在这个框架里系统探索 higher-order recurrence。相比只做某个 kernel trick 或某个 SSM 在需要跨多步传播信息的任务上优于一阶递推，说明额外的递推阶数确实带来可用表达能力，而不是纯理论自由度。\n\n语言模型部分则用小到中等规模预训练配置比较不同 mixer 的困惑度和效率。摘要和正文可见的重点不是刷新某个公开榜单，而是展示一条连续的复杂度-性能曲线：O(n) 方案最省，但能力受限；引入 O(n log n) 或 O(n^{3/2}) 结构后，性能向 attention The filtering belief over memory becomes the recurrent state. Standard MoE selects top-K experts and combines their outputs with a weighted sum. That operation is permutation-invariant, so it only depends on the selected set, not on order, role, or interaction among experts. The authors argue that this makes aggregation itself an expressivity bottleneck. The core problem is therefore how to increase the compositional capacity of MoE without changing the router, without redesigning experts, and without paying the routing-side cost of ever finer-grained expert configurations.","importance":"The main value for pretraining researchers is conceptual. The paper also makes a useful point: MoE capacity is not only about expert count and sparsity, but also about the operator used to compose expert outputs. That said, this looks more like a meaningful architectural extension than a result that immediately changes mainstream large-scale MoE recipes.","technical_approach":"$45","experiments":"$46","reading_guide":"For a quick pass, focus on three parts. The full-rank property of transformer residual streams invalidates cross-layer subspace coupling assumptions during actual forward passes, providing constraints for the design of low-rank compression and low-rank adaptation algorithms.","technical_approach":"It unifies all existing SVD-based low-rank compression methods into an optimization framework on a Grassmannian fiber bundle, parameterized by a 2D continuous design space: anchor strength λ (λ=0 for full cross-layer coupling, λ→∞ for pure per-layer compression) and section tying degree (interpolating from per-layer independent subspaces to globally shared subspaces). Attention Run-time Termination for Efficient Large Language Model Decoding","abstract":"","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2606_00024.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是长上下文解码里的一个很具体、也很硬的瓶颈：注意力计算并不总是需要把全部 KV cache 都读完，但现有方法大多在解码前用 key-only 规则做静态裁剪，无法在真正执行 attention 时根据 key 和 value 的联合作用决定“后面的 KV block 还值不值得继续读”。论文要解决的核心问题，是如何在 FlashAttention 这类流式 kernel 内部，用几乎不增加额外开销的方式，在线判断当前 query 的注意力输出是否已经基本收敛，从而提前终止后续 KV block 的访存与计算。","importance":"对基座研究本身，它不是训练范式论文，而是推理侧的 kernel-level 方法。但它有两点启发比较实在。第一，它指出现有大量 KV 管理方法把 token 重要性近似成 key 或 attention score 的函数，这个近似和最终输出影响并不一致；真正决定输出的是 softmax 权重和 value 向量共同形成的加权和。第二，它把“输出是否收敛”变成运行时信号，而不是预估信号，这种思路比离线 importance predictor 更贴近真实计算路径，也更容易和已有 pruning/eviction 方法叠加。量级上看，它更像一个可组合的系统优化模块，而不是改变解码范式的工作。","technical_approach":"方法核心是 ART，Attention Run-time Termination。它利用 FlashAttention 的块式流式执行特性：KV 被分成多个 block 顺序处理，kernel 在每处理完一个 block 后，内部都会得到一次中间 attention 输出 O^(t)。论文的观察是，很多 query 的 O^(t) 会在遍历完整个 KV 序列之前就趋于稳定，后续 block 对输出的增量很小。\n\n因此 ART 不再提前预测哪些 token 重要，而是在 kernel 执行过程中直接监控中间输出的变化。终止判据不是单看幅值变化，也不是单看方向变化，而是同时看两件事：\n1. scale stability：连续若干步中，输出更新量的范数是否已经足够小；\n2. directional stability：更新方向是否已经和当前输出方向基本一致，说明后续只是在做很小的同向修正，而不是还存在明显的方向性重写。\n\n这种设计的关键点在于，它试图近似“剩余未处理 KV 对最终输出的边际贡献是否可忽略”。只看 attention score 不够，因为高权重 token 的 value 可能接近零，低权重 token 的 value 也可能在某个方向上产生显著偏移。ART 直接在输出空间判断收敛，等于把 key-value 联合作用隐式纳入了判据。\n\n从实现上，它嵌入在 block-wise attention kernel 内部，不需要额外训练 predictor，也不需要在解码前做离线分析。因为中间状态本来就在 FlashAttention 的 streaming softmax 过程中存在，所以额外成本主要是少量统计量维护和阈值判断。论文还强调它与已有 key-based KV 管理方法正交：先用外部方法缩小候选 KV，再由 ART 在运行时进一步提前停止，二者可以叠加。","experiments":"实验主要在长上下文生成场景和 LongBench 上做，关注吞吐、延迟和质量保持。论文给出的主结论是：在大 batch 解码时，相比已有基线，ART 带来超过 20% 的 generation throughput 提升，同时生成质量损失可以忽略。这个结果的重要前提是 ART 不是单独替代所有 KV 管理方法，而是作为运行时 refinement 模块叠加到现有方法上，因此收益来自两部分：减少无效 KV block 读取，以及减少对应的 attention 计算。\n\n从文中描述看，作者做了几类关键分析：\n1. 输出收敛性可视化：展示 O^(t) 随 block Temperature is not a minor hyperparameter in distillation; it controls how much probability mass the teacher assigns to non-top tokens. The paper shows that temperature affects FKL and RKL asymmetrically. With appropriate temperature, simple KL-based objectives can become competitive with more elaborate variants. For pretraining researchers, the useful lesson is that soft-target entropy, gradient allocation across vocabulary items, and objective choice jointly determine how efficiently a student inherits behavior from a teacher.","technical_approach":"The analysis compares temperature-scaled FKL, D_KL(p^τ || q^τ), and RKL, D_KL(q^τ || p^τ), where p^τ and q^τ are teacher and student distributions under softmax temperature τ. RKL gradients are weighted by the student distribution, so increasing τ mainly changes optimization scale and smoothness. Under centered logits and in the high-temperature limit, both objectives approach logit matching, which explains why their distinction vanishes asymptotically. In this paper, we propose \\textbf{ProjQ}, a novel fr","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-05-30T02:54:40+00:00","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2606_00494.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作解决的是量化与 LoRA 顺序组合里的一个结构性错配问题。常见部署流程是先做 PTQ，再做 LoRA/QLoRA 适配，但普通 PTQ 产生的量化噪声在权重空间里往往是分散的、各向同性的，其中很多误差分量并不落在低秩适配器容易修复的子空间里。结果是 LoRA 的有限秩一部分被迫拿去“擦屁股”，修补随机量化误差，而不是用于真正的任务迁移。作者要解决的是：在不知道下游任务的情况下，能否在量化阶段就主动塑形噪声，让主要误差尽量落入后续低秩适配器可吸收的子空间，从而保留更多适配容量给任务本身。","importance":"这项工作更偏部署与后训练，但对基座研究也有启发，尤其是 pretrain 到 post-train 接口怎么设计。它指出一个常被忽略的问题：压缩不是独立于适配的预处理步骤，压缩误差的几何结构会直接决定后续 PEFT 的有效容量。这个视角比单纯追求更低量化误差更有信息量，因为它关心的是“哪些误差可被后续训练机制修复，哪些不可”。如果这个思路成立，那么未来不只是 PTQ+LoRA，蒸馏、剪枝、低秩更新、甚至持续预训练中的参数冻结策略，都可以按“后续可校正性”来设计。贡献量级上，它不是改变预训练范式的工作，但在低比特部署链路里提出了一个清楚、可分析的接口目标：correctability-aware quantization。","technical_approach":"方法核心是把量化目标从传统的权重重构，改成“经过最优低秩修正后的层输出重构”。设原始权重为 W，量化后为 W_hat，校准输入为 X，LoRA 形式的低秩修正为 BA。作者优化的是层输出误差 ||(W - W_hat - BA)X|| 这一类目标，而不是只最小化 ||W - W_hat||。这样做有两个直接后果。\n\n第一，它是 activation-aware 的。也就是误差是否重要，不由权重本身大小决定，而由它通过输入激活 X 对层输出造成的影响决定。这一点针对了很多 weight-only 方法的弱点：有些权重即便量化误差大，对当前层输出影响也很小；反过来，一些沿高能激活方向的误差即便数值不大，也会严重伤害模型。\n\n第二，它显式引入了“可由低秩适配器修复”的结构约束。外层优化 W_hat 时，不再追求把所有误差都均匀压小，而是尽量把主导误差压进某个低秩子空间；内层优化 BA 则给出在该子空间上的最优局部补偿。作者把这称为 structural noise shaping：不是只减小噪声幅度，而是改变噪声的方向分布。\n\n求解上，ProjQ 使用交替优化。直观上，一步在给定量化权重时求最优低秩修正子空间，另一步在给定子空间时做投影约束下的量化，使量化噪声更多落在该低秩流形里。摘要和引言还提到正交子空间投影，这意味着作者不是简单把量化残差做低秩分解，而是区分“可校正分量”和“正交残差”，目标是最小化后者。理论部分给出收敛性和容量保留方面的论证：相比标准 PTQ，投影式量化会把更多误差留在 adapter 能处理的方向上，因此为下游任务保留更多自由度。\n\n与 LoftQ 一类方法相比，差异主要有三点。其一，优化目标从权重空间转到输出空间，更接近实际功能误差。其二，不只是联合初始化量化与 LoRA，而是显式塑造量化噪声的子空间结构。其三，作者强调有理论保证，而不是只靠经验初始化收益。","experiments":"从全文片段能确认的实验结论是：ProjQ 在多种 benchmark 上都优于独立 PTQ+LoRA/QLoRA 以及 LoftQ 一类基线，表现为更低的评估 loss、更好的下游适配效果，并且在更低 bit 下也能接近标准基线性能。引言没有给出完整数字，但已经明确比较维度包括两类：一是量化误差补偿能力，二是下游任务适配质量。\n\n阅读实验时建议重点找四类结果。第一，低比特区间，尤其 2-bit/4-bit 下，相比 QLoRA 或普通 PTQ+LoRA 的差距有多大；如果收益只在极低 bit 才明显，那它更像部署专用技巧。第二，rank 敏感性：在相同 LoRA rank 下 ProjQ 是否更强，或者在更小 rank 下达到相近性能，这直接对应“释放适配容量”的主张。第三，activation-aware 目标的贡献：若去掉输入激活 X，只做 weight-space 版本，性能下降多少。第四，交替优化和投影步骤的消融：如果没有正交投影或没有联合求解，效果是否明显回落。\n\n如果正文给出了层级重构误差、奇异值谱或误差在低秩子空间/正交子空间中的分解图，这些图会比最终任务分数更能说明方法是否真的在做 noise shaping，而不只是更复杂的量化初始化。","reading_guide":"先看 Problem Formulation，把目标函数读明白。这篇的关键不在实现细节，而在目标换了：从 weight reconstruction 变成 output reconstruction after optimal low-rank correction。只要这个点抓住，后面的算法和理论都顺了。\n\n然后看算法部分，重点确认交替优化每一步到底在解什么，正交投影是如何定义的，量化约束和低秩约束如何耦合。这里要特别留意作者是否给出闭式解、近似解，还是依赖启发式迭代，因为这决定方法在大模型多层量化时的可扩展性。\n\n理论部分建议只抓两个结论：收敛性条件，以及为什么它“严格保留更多下游容量”。如果证明依赖较强假设，比如局部线性化、固定校准分布或最优内层解可得，需要记下来，因为这些会影响方法在真实 LLM 上的稳健性。\n\n实验部分优先看 bit-width、LoRA rank、校准集大小三个维度的消融，再看与 LoftQ/QLoRA 的主表。泛读大约 30 到 45 分钟；如果你关心压缩与 PEFT 的接口设计，值得把理论和消融一起看完，大约 1 到 1.5 小时。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper addresses a structural mismatch in the standard deployment pipeline of PTQ followed by LoRA. 场景下最强的保守证书之一；也就是说，只靠边缘置信度，理论上很难再做得更强。另一个重要点是它和旧规则的关系。作者证明在 equal-confidence 特例下，新规则会退化回 Fast-dLLM 的 factor decoding，因此它不是另起炉灶，而是对 homogeneous-confidence 假设的严格推广。\n\n论文还给出 heterogeneity bonus 分解，解释为什么 The main lesson is that quantization robustness should be optimized jointly for weights and activations at the level of matrix-multiplication output error, not only by smoothing one side of the computation. AURA-Mem (Action-Utility Recurrent Adaptive 动作驱动写门控”。具体有四个关键部件。第一，外层包一个 constant-size recurrent memory，替代随时间增长的 KV-cache。无论 episode 多长，显存中的状态大小不变。第二，引入 learned action-utility write gate。门控的触发信号不是语言建模里常见的 perplexity、也不是 recency Search（EOS）。它先假设一个冻结的多模态基础模型，在若干 decoder layer 上对视觉 token 做压缩，但不再预先固定压缩策略，而是把三类决策都参数化为可学习变量。\n\n第一部分是统一算子空间。每个激活的压缩层先根据 token importance 选出 K 个 anchor token，其余 token 作为待压缩集合。随后计算待压缩 token 与 anchor 的归一化相似度矩阵，并通过温度参数 τ 控制 assignment 的尖锐程度：τ 小时更接近 hard merge，τ 大时更接近 soft redistribution 或 pooling。再通过 transfer gate 控制被压缩 token 的信息是否保留并转移到 anchor 上；如果 gate 关闭，就接近 pruning；如果开启，再结合 assignment 形式，就能落在 bou","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-05-28T18:19:32Z","category_id":"eval","cover_url":"/covers/2605_30448.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作讨论的不是“学生模型答得像不像老师”，而是一个更接近部署现实的问题：在只有黑盒 API 访问的条件下，蒸馏后的学生模型，是否会在可观察行为上与教师模型难以区分。作者指出，常见的语义相似度、任务正确率、输出重合度，只能说明答案内容接近，不能说明行为层面的细粒度模式也被迁移了。这里的行为包括风格、拒答策略、格式习惯、冲突指令处理、安全边界和鲁棒性反应。为此，论文提出 bounded behavioral indistinguishability，把“不可区分”定义成一个带约束的经验命题：在给定提示分布、查询预算、计算预算和对手类别下，任何对手都不能以超过 ε 的优势判断输出来自教师还是学生。","importance":"对预训练研究本身，这篇论文不是训练方法创新，而是蒸馏评估口径的修正。它的价值在于提醒人们：黑盒蒸馏如果只看 task accuracy 或 semantic match，很容易高估行为迁移质量。对于做 continual pretrain、teacher-student distillation、API imitation、合成数据蒸馏的人，这个视角很有用，因为它把“蒸馏成功”从单点指标改成了带威胁模型的行为保真问题。贡献量级偏评估框架和概念澄清，不是会直接改写训练 recipe 的工作，但它提出的残余可区分性分析，确实能帮助判断蒸馏到底迁移了什么、没迁移什么。","technical_approach":"方法上有两层。第一层是形式化定义。学生 S 对教师 T 的行为不可区分性，不再被当作绝对性质，而是写成 (ε, q, t, A)-behavioral indistinguishability：在显式 prompt distribution 上，任意属于对手类 A 的区分器，在查询预算 q 和计算预算 t 内，区分教师与学生的优势不超过 ε。这个定义的关键不是理论证明，而是把评估对象、攻击能力和数据分布都钉住，避免“不可区分”被说成无条件结论。\n\n第二层是经验化评估管线。作者没有依赖单一 judge，而是组合了几类互补测试：1）response-only discriminator，只看回答文本，检测风格、长度、措辞等表面残留；2）prompt-response discriminator，把上下文一起输入，判断回答是否像该教师在该提示下会给出的输出；3）semantic similarity，衡量内容接近程度；4）policy-level agreement，关注安全、拒答、边界行为是否一致；5）pairwise teacher-identification judge，给同一 prompt 的两个回答，让裁判判断哪个更像教师，并做 A/B swap consistency filtering 来降低位置偏置。最后再做 category-wise 分析，看哪些类型的 prompt 最容易暴露蒸馏痕迹。\n\n实验设置上，作者选了两个模型家族：Qwen 和 Llama。每个家族都比较教师、原始 base student、以及基于教师黑盒响应做 LoRA 蒸馏后的 student。训练方式不是全参蒸馏，而是低秩适配，这一点很重要，因为它更接近现实里低成本 API distillation 的做法，也意味着论文测到的是“有限容量适配下的行为迁移上限”，不是理想化 fully finetuned student 的结果。\n\n另外一个值得注意的点是数据获取策略。作者比较了 disagreement-guided acquisition 和 stratified random sampling。前者试图优先采集教师与学生分歧大的样本，后者强调覆盖和多样性。结果显示前者并没有稳定胜出，这说明在行为蒸馏里，覆盖面可能比局部难例挖掘更重要，至少在他们的预算和任务设定下如此。","experiments":"实验核心围绕一个 5,000 条 prompt 的受控 behavioral probe suite，覆盖 general QA、reasoning、coding、summarization、style/format control、ambiguous prompts、safety-boundary、instruction conflict、domain-technical、robustness perturbations 等类别。作者明确说这不是自然分布，而是用于测残余行为差异的探针分布。\n\n主要结果有三点。第一，LoRA 蒸馏确实提升了语义相似度，也让 learned discriminators 更难区分教师和学生，说明黑盒响应蒸馏能迁移相当一部分可观察行为。第二，这种改进并不等于行为不可区分。最直观的数字来自 pairwise teacher-identification：在 Qwen 家族上，区分优势从 base student 的 0.158 降到 LoRA student 的 0.081。下降接近一半，说明蒸馏有效；但优势仍显著大于 0，说明残余痕迹还在。第三，残余可区分性并不是均匀分布的。category-wise 分析显示 style/format、robustness perturbation、domain-technical prompt 上最容易暴露差异，这意味着蒸馏更容易学到“答什么”，较难学到“怎么答”和“在边界条件下如何稳定地答”。\n\n作者还做了 query-budget 相关实验，比较不同采样策略在有限 API 调用预算下的效果。结论是 disagreement-guided acquisition 没有稳定优于分层随机采样。这一点对蒸馏实践有现实意义：如果预算有限，先保证 prompt 覆盖和类别多样性，可能比复杂的主动采样更稳。\n\n从论文给出的信息看，这篇工作更强调评估信号的一致性，而不是追求某个单一数字。也就是说，semantic similarity 改善、discriminator 变弱、pairwise judge 优势下降，这几条证据共同支持“蒸馏让学生更像教师，但还没有像到难以区分”。","reading_guide":"泛读时先看引言里对 output 偏好目标和评测协议之间可能在共同塑造一种低维偏差。这个结论对做 reward 建模、合成偏好数据、自动化 eval 的人都很重要。","technical_approach":"技术上最有价值的是它把 LLM-as-judge 形式化成“潜在质量流形上的低秩投影器”。作者先假设一个回答表示 h 可以分解为 style、fact、culture 等近似正交的子空间；人类评分函数会按 rubric 在这些子空间上加权，客观 rubric 更偏 fact，主观 rubric 则会把 cultural/contextual 维度也纳入。LLM judge 则被建模为一个秩较低的正交投影 PJ，分数由投影后能量决定。若 judge 的表征基础主要来自 next-token 预训练和常见 post-train 目标，它更容易对 fluency、常见事实、模型熟悉的表达方向敏感，而对文化语境、社区规范、细微价值判断这些低频但人类在意的维度投影不足。这样就会出现：不同 LLM judge 因共享训练分布和对齐目标而投向相似低维子空间，所以彼此相关；但这个子空间和人类评分子空间夹角很大，所以和人类不对齐。\n\n围绕这个几何假设，论文提出四类诊断量。1）score spread compression：比较 judge 与 human 的打分方差，若 σJ/σH 明显小于 1，说明 judge 把主观差异压扁了。2）effective rank：看评分矩阵需要多少主成分才能解释 95% 方差，若 judge 的有效秩显著低于 human，说明其评价维度更少。3）principal angle to human subspace：直接测 judge 子空间与 human 子空间的主夹角，并与 inter-human 的夹角下界比较。4）stacked correlations / null-space fraction：看 LLM-LLM 相关是否系统高于 LLM-human，以及人类评分变化中有多少落在 judge 的“盲区”。\n\n方法设计上还有两个细节很关键。其一，作者不是只测原始 judge，还系统比较了 in-context demonstration、SFT、DPO、以及 post-hoc demonstration-anchored calibration 四种干预，想回答“训练能不能把 judge 拉回人类子空间”。其二，数据选在 Indic 多语言、社区健康、文化问答这类真实主观场景，而不是英语单一、事实核验型 benchmark，这让几何诊断更接近真实部署难点。","experiments":"实验覆盖 4 个社区构建的 Indic 数据集、8 种 Indic 语言、41 个 LLM judges。数据里既有文化问答，也有社区健康场景；每个样本有 3 位独立人类评审，rubric 横跨 objective 到 subjective。模型侧包含 14 个基础 judge，以及 27 个经过训练、偏好优化或校准的变体，来自 3 个模型家族，规模从 3B 到 405B。统计上使用 paired item bootstrap 给出区间，而不是只报点估计。\n\n主结果很清楚。对于主观 rubric，LLM judge 的 score spread 只有人类的一部分，σJ/σH 约在 0.3–0.5，说明打分动态范围被明显压缩。几何上，judge 子空间与 human 子空间几乎正交，主夹角约 87–89°，而人类之间的夹角约 78–81°；也就是说，judge 离 human 比 human 彼此之间更远。相关性上，LLM-LLM Pearson 大约 0.35，而 LLM-human 约 0.1 左右甚至更低，形成“彼此一致但不贴近人类”的典型模式。只有在带可验证事实答案的 objective rubric 上，这个 gap 才明显收敛，说明问题不是 LLM 完全不会评，而是对高内在维度的主观评价会发生秩塌缩。\n\n干预实验也很有信息量。SFT 和 DPO 往往能恢复一部分 score spread，让 judge 不再那么“缩分”，但 principal angle 改善很有限，说明训练可能让分数更分散，却没有真正学到人类评价维度；有些 rubric 上甚至会退化。相对而言，post-hoc 的 demonstration-anchored calibration 是唯一一个在 community-health 四个 rubric 上都带来一致提升的方案，但仍达不到人类可靠性水平。作者还给出 boundary condition：当 judge 的可表达维度 kJ 小于某个 rubric 下人类评分流形的内在维度 dR 时，就会出现 consensual blindness。这个解释和实验现象是对得上的：客观 rubric 的 dR 低，主观 rubric 的 dR 高。","reading_guide":"这篇值得精读。建议先看第 2 节的几何建模，再看第 4 节实验。读法上不要先盯相关系数表，而要先弄清四个诊断量各自回答什么问题。score compression 回答“judge 是否把差异压平”；effective rank 回答“judge 实际用了多少评价维度”；principal angle 回答“judge 看问题的方向是否接近人类”；stacked correlations 回答“高 inter-LLM agreement 到底是不是好事”。把这四个量串起来，论文的主张就很完整了。\n\n重点图表应优先看：主观与客观 rubric 的 spread 对比图、effective rank 分布、judge-human 与 human-human 的 principal angle 而忽视文化维度。第二，demonstration-anchored calibration 为什么比继续训练更有效，它是在重标定分数尺度，还是在局部旋转评价子空间。第三，几何诊断能否前置到 reward model 或 synthetic preference pipeline 中，作为训练前的质量门槛。完整读完大约需要 60–90 分钟。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper asks a sharper question than whether LLM judges are merely “good” or “bad”: why do LLM judges agree strongly with each other while Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from dynamic evaluation and contamination control, rather than from a new training method. Static public benchmarks are increasingly weak signals for model choice because items can leak into pretraining corpora. CoEval proposes a renewable evaluation pipeline: generate a fresh task-specific benchmark from a task description and rank candidate models with a cross-family judge ensemble. This is useful for internal model iteration, continual-pretraining regression tests, and deployment-oriented model selection under a target distribution.","technical_approach":"CoEval has two main components. First, a teacher model synthesizes an attribute-stratified benchmark from a domain or task specification, controlling dimensions such as capability, difficulty, and subdomain coverage. Since items are generated anew for each run, the benchmark is designed to reduce exposure to student-model training data. Second, candidate model responses are scored by a judge ensemble drawn from different model vendors or families. The paper’s central methodological point is that judge composition matters more than judge count. A diverse panel can reduce same-family self-preference, while adding low-agreement judges can make reliability worse. The aggregation scheme also aims to cancel verbosity bias because individual judges may have biases with different signs.","experiments":"The reported medium-scale study covers four tasks and produces 7,978 valid evaluations at an end-to-end cost of USD 5.89. In settings where ground truth exists, CoEval recovers the correct model ranking and its label-free judging correlates with ground-truth correctness at rho = 0.86. experiments","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"","category_id":"eval","cover_url":"/covers/2606_05384.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.AI","cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作研究的是 会不会有随机波动，而是它是否缺乏对抗性鲁棒性，导致评测结果并不是固定属性，而是可被事后操纵的对话产物。","importance":"对预训练本身没有直接方法贡献，但对后训练、对齐和评测基础设施有现实影响。现在很多模型迭代、偏好优化、reward model 校验、公开榜单比较，都依赖 LLM judge。如果 judge The bridge between them is token merging. An input image is encoded by a shared CNN into L visual tokens, which are then processed by an attention encoder equipped with token-merging modules. Similar tokens are clustered into K merged tokens, and the model records a source map that maps the original tokens to their merged groups. This source map supervises both branches. In the VAE branch, merged-token alignment regularizes the continuous latent space toward semantically grouped representations. In the VQ branch, group-aware quantization uses the induced groups to guide codebook learning, encouraging diversity within groups and separation across groups. feature heuristic 的方法在 VLM 上基本失效，因为这些文本信号并不对应视觉理解是否正确；majority voting 只有在 CoT 条件下才有小幅稳定收益，不带 CoT 时几乎无效。\n\n第二层是理论分析。作者把 voting 的收益写成与预测间依赖性相关的函数，核心结论是：如果多个样本不是近似独立，而是带有较强正相关，那么投票无法像经典 self-consistency 直觉那样显著降低错误率。单模型多次采样时，所有输出共享同一个视觉编码器、同一套对齐误差和相近的解码偏置，所以相关性天然较高。这个分析解释了为什么“多采样”在 VLM 上通常不如在文本推理里有效。\n\n第三层是方法设计。作者提出 ETTC（Entropy-based TTC）。它不是简单统计最终答案频次，而是先在每个模型内部基于多次响应形成答案分布，再用熵衡量该分布的集中程度，选择熵更低、也就是内部更一致的预测。这样做的动机是：在多模型集成里，不同模型能力不同，弱模型数量多时，majority voting 可能让它们凭相关错误压过强模型；而 ETTC 用“分布是否尖锐”来近似模型在当前样本上的可靠性。作者还说明，在单模型场景下 ETTC 会退化为 majority voting，因此它兼容已有 self-consistency 设定；但在多模型场景下，它能利用模型间置信差异。与传统加权投票不同，这里不需要额外训练一个 judge 或 reward model，仍属于 inference-only 策略。","experiments":"从给出的全文内容看，实验覆盖 7 个开源 VLM 和 6 个 benchmark，并设计了两种多模型配置：一类是相近规模但不同家族的 cross-family ensemble，包括 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct、LLaMA-3.2-11B-Vision、Gemma-3-12B-it、Pixtral-12B-2409；另一类是同家族不同规模的 same-family ensemble。作者重点报告了几类结果。\n\n第一，feature-based selection 基本不能提升准确率，说明在 VLM 中，文本表面特征不是可靠的正确性信号。第二，单模型 majority voting 只有 modest but consistent gains，而且依赖 CoT；没有 CoT 时，聚合几乎没有收益。第三，作者通过依赖性分析和实证统计表明，模型输出存在弱但非零的相关性，这已经足以显著压缩 voting 的理论收益。第四，在多模型集成中，ETTC 稳定优于标准 majority voting，并且在若干设置下超过 ensemble 中最强的单个模型，这一点是全文最重要的经验结果，因为它说明小模型并非只能拖后腿，只要聚合方式能识别样本级可靠性，小模型可以补足大模型的盲区。\n\n受限于当前提供的全文片段，具体 benchmark 名称、各表格中的精确提升幅度、采样次数 N、以及 ETTC 相对 voting 的逐项数字没有完整展开。如果后续拿到附录，建议重点补齐：单模型 CoT / no-CoT 下的绝对增益，dependency 指标的定义与估计方式，以及 ETTC 在 cross-family 与 same-family 两种 ensemble 上的差异。","reading_guide":"这篇适合泛读，不需要逐行推公式。建议先看 Introduction，抓住作者真正想回答的问题：不是“怎么把 VLM 的 TTC 做得更花”，而是“为什么它通常不太灵”。然后看实验设置部分，确认单模型与多模型、CoT 与非 CoT 的区分。接着重点看第 4 节关于 prediction dependency 的理论和实证，这部分是全文最有价值的地方，因为它把经验现象和统计结构连起来了。最后看第 5 节 ETTC：关注它和 majority voting 的关系、何时退化为同一方法、为什么在异质 ensemble TTC”的现象是否也出现在纯文本多样本推理，只是程度更轻；二是能否把 ETTC 的思想前移到训练阶段，做样本级校准或多专家协同训练。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper asks a precise question: why do test-time compute (TTC) methods, which often help LLM reasoning, bring only limited gains in vision-language models, and when do they actually work? The main answer is not “sample more and vote.” It is that single-model TTC in VLMs is bottlenecked by insufficient prediction diversity. Many VLM failures originate in visual perception or vision-language alignment, and these errors remain highly correlated across repeated samples from the same model. As a result, stochastic decoding alone does not create the kind of independent evidence that makes self-consistency effective in text-only settings. The paper then formalizes this through prediction dependence: as outputs become more correlated, the benefit of majority voting collapses. Real gains come from structural diversity across models, not from randomness within one model.","importance":"For pretraining-oriented readers, the value is mostly diagnostic rather than algorithmic. This is a useful lesson for ensemble design, verifier-free reranking, and possibly multi-expert training. block；这些共享 attention block 在不同深度通过轻量 LoRA 投影做位置特化。这样做的理由很明确：Mamba2 负责线性时间序列处理和常数状态解码，Transformer block 负责内容寻址能力，弥补纯 SSM 在 in-context retrieval 上的短板。\n\n从报告给出的叙述看，Zamba2-VL 重点不是提出新的视觉 tokenizer token 数不变，只要把语言骨干从全 attention 改成 hybrid SSM-attention，prefill 和生成状态管理就会出现结构性改善。\n\n如果从预训练研究角度看，真正值得注意的是 shared Transformer blocks 的设计。它不是在每层都保留 attention，而是把 attention 当作稀缺资源，只在少数位置提供全局内容寻址，再用 LoRA VLM，如 Molmo2、Qwen3-VL、InternVL3.5，处于可竞争区间；同时明显强于此前的 SSM 或混合 VLM，如 VL-Mamba、Cobra、mmMamba。效率侧是最核心结果：依托 Zamba2 骨干的近线性 prefill 和近常数 recurrent state，Zamba2-VL 在 matched parameter scale 下的 than a faster-but-weaker alternative to Transformer VLMs. The tension is twofold. Transformer VLMs become expensive quickly under high-resolution images, long visual sequences, and video because prefill cost and KV cache scale poorly. Pure Mamba/SSM VLMs improve efficiency, but often lose accuracy on tasks that require precise in-context lookup, such as grounding, referring expressions, and fine-grained retrieval. Existing options are unsatisfying in different ways. Tool-based approaches can explicitly crop, zoom, or manipulate images and often perform well, but they are slow and limited to predefined operations. Latent visual reasoning internalizes intermediate visual states inside the model, but most prior methods generate latent tokens autoregressively. That creates two problems: latent tokens become overly homogeneous and carry weak visual information, and later latents depend more on earlier latent hidden states than on the original image features. DeepLatent aims to replace autoregressive latent-token generation with parallel, image-grounded latent-state generation.","importance":"This is not a core pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to new modeling paradigms and to the interface between pretraining and post-training. If the latent state is fundamentally a spatial field, flattening it into a 1D causal chain introduces a structural bias. That observation is useful beyond this paper, including for masked, any-order, diffusion, and latent-reasoning style models. A second useful point is methodological: the paper applies RL directly to continuous latent modulation parameters rather than only to discrete text outputs. That provides a concrete example of optimizing intermediate reasoning states in embedding space. ","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-05-29T20:01:06+00:00","category_id":"multimodal","cover_url":"/covers/2606_00324.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.IR","cs.AI"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是生成式推荐里一个很具体但长期被低估的问题：Semantic encoder 的结构化离散模态，这个视角和视觉 encoder、音频 codec depth model 是一致的。这个判断对统一多模态预训练、语音/图像离散 token 建模、以及任何“层级离散表示接入 LLM”的问题都很有参考价值。贡献量级上，它不是在改 Transformer 主干，而是在 pretrain interface 上做了一个低成本但有效的结构注入：把 prefix recommendation 的标准做法：把每个 item 编成 L 层 SID，扩展 tokenizer 加入 L×K 个层级 SID token，然后用单阶段 causal LM 训练三类序列：text-sid 交错、单 item 的 text↔sid 配对、以及 sid-only 序列。这样一个模型同时学顺序建模、SID 生成和 SID-text grounding。\n\n真正的改动发生在 SID token 进入 Transformer 之前。对于层级 ℓ 的 SID token，PrefixMem 读取其前面 1..ℓ-1 层 code 构成的 prefix，用 hash-based prefix n-gram memory table 做稀疏查表，得到一个 prefix-conditioned 向量，再加到该 SID token embedding 上。于是同一个 code 在不同 prefix 下会有不同输入表示。作者强调两点：\n1) 这不是让 LLM 在 attention 里自己推断 prefix 语义，而是在输入侧直接提供条件化表示；\n2) 记忆表是稀疏参数，不需要 transformer FLOPs，可以在 item corpus 上独立预训练，再接到不同 LLM 家族上。\n\n从设计取舍看，作者比较了 hash memory 和 transformer encoder 两类 SID encoder，结论偏向前者。原因不是 transformer 不够强，而是这里需要的是对 prefix→representation 的高效、可扩展、可迁移记忆，而不是再堆一个高算力序列模型。hash memory 更贴合 billion-scale catalog 的稀疏统计结构，也更容易和现有 LLM 解耦。论文还强调它与 constrained decoding、smart initialization 是互补关系：前者解决输出合法性，后者改善冷启动 embedding，而 PrefixMem 解决的是“同一 code 在不同 prefix 下语义不同”这一表示问题。","experiments":"实验基于 Pinterest 的 billion-scale 数据，覆盖多个 LLM 家族，包括 Qwen、Llama、Gemma。论文给出的主结果有几项比较清楚：\n1) 在 matched compute 下，最深层 SID accuracy 最多提升 46% relative；full-SID retrieval recall 最多提升 22% relative。\n2) 提升主要集中在 hard cases，也就是 greedy decoding 原本容易失败的样本；这些样本上最深层准确率最多提升 77% relative。这一点很重要，说明 PrefixMem 不是只在 easy majority 上做平滑增益，而是在真正受 prefix 歧义影响的长尾样本上起作用。\n3) SID-to-text grounding 也明显改善，BLEU 提升 33%。这支持作者的论点：模块不仅帮助“把 code 续对”，也帮助模型理解 SID 个未访问候选里让强模型选“最相关”的下一个实体，并周期性插入 mad walk 来跳出局部区域，避免路径过窄。随后用强模型把整条实体链改写成一个必须逐跳推理的问题，并要求：不能暴露实体名、日期、地点等可直接匹配的线索；答案唯一；同时输出每一跳的 gold entity。这样得到的是可验证的多跳问题和显式中间链。\n\n第二部分是干扰项构造。与随机采样无关文档不同，作者调用搜索 agent feEdback）的核心是把“prompt 级别的 value”当作自适应锚点，把 on-policy 采样到的多个回答转成可训练 RM 的偏好对。\n\n1) Value-anchored RM：在 RM 里加入一个 prompt-specific 的 value head V(x)，估计在当前采样 policy 下该 prompt 的期望 reward。这个 V(x) 不是传统 PPO repair”拉回到模型参数内部能力，说明这类失真可以通过训练目标直接矫正，而不一定依赖外部控制环。第二，它提出的 teacher 不是更强模型，而是同一 backbone 在 canonical Full prompt 下的自身能力，这一点很重要：它把问题表述成“保住模型本来就有、但在污染上下文下丢失的能力”，而不是传统蒸馏里从强教师迁移能力。第三，作者只用 sharded GSM8K 风格数学对话做训练，却在五类非数学任务上拿到 zero-shot 改善，说明这种信号学到的不是狭义数学技巧，而更像一种对最终证据重 grounding、抑制 assistant-side anchor 的通用行为偏置。对做 post-train recipe、continual pretrain、multi-turn SFT 的人，这个角度是有参考价值的。","technical_approach":"方法叫 Canonical-Context On-Policy Distillation，简称 CCOPD。训练时同一个 base model 分成两个角色。冻结的 teacher 看到 clean canonical Full prompt，也就是把全部用户证据一次性给全；可训练的 student 只看到 Raw-Sharded 多轮历史，也就是用户证据被拆成多轮，并且中间夹着 student 自己在信息不完整时生成的回复。关键监督只发生在“最终答案阶段”：当所有 task-relevant evidence 都已经在多轮里揭示完之后，student 先按自己的当前策略生成 final answer prefix，teacher 再在相同 prefix 下、但基于 Full prompt 计算 token 分布，对 student 做 same-prefix distillation。这里有两个设计点值得注意。其一，它是 on-policy 的，因为监督建立在 student 自己生成的答案前缀上，而不是离线 teacher forcing 到某条固定参考答案；这样训练时能直接覆盖那些由 student 自己 earlier mistakes 导致的偏移轨迹。其二，它采用 reverse-KL 风格的 token-level distillation，目标是把 student 在污染历史下的分布拉回 Full-context teacher 的分布。作者强调 same-prefix 很关键，因为如果 prefix 不对齐，teacher 和 student 会在不同解码轨道上比较，监督会变弱甚至失真。论文还把 canonical-context consistency 形式化为 task-equivalent presentation 下 final-answer distribution 的不变性，并定义了一个在共享答案前缀下比较 next-token 分布差异的局部诊断量，用来定位 presentation sensitivity 在哪些前缀位置最严重。与已有做法相比，CCOPD 不改推理流程，不加反思/重写 loop，也不要求模型先学会澄清提问；它直接针对“最终证据已齐但仍被旧回复污染”的情形做参数更新。","experiments":"实验设置围绕 task-equivalent sharding 展开，核心比较三种输入形式：Full、Concat、Raw-Sharded。Full 是一次性完整提示；Concat 是把多轮用户证据拼接但去掉中间 assistant 污染；Raw-Sharded 则保留真实多轮结构和中间模型回复。CCOPD 只在 sharded GSM8K-style math conversations 上训练，但评测覆盖六个任务家族，其中五个是非数学 zero-shot 迁移。主结果是：相对未修改 base model，Raw-Sharded 表现平均相对提升 32%，同时 Full 和 Concat 基本保持，不出现明显能力回退。这个结果说明它不是简单把模型推向某种保守回答风格，否则 Full/Concat 也会受损。消融部分给出的信息量比较足。作者比较了 canonical Full teacher 与其他替代监督，结论是收益确实来自“对齐同模型在 Full 视角下的行为”，而不是任意蒸馏都行。进一步地，当同一 backbone 在 Full prompt 下已经足够强时，继续增大 teacher scale 带来的额外收益有限，这支持作者的论点：问题主要不是 teacher 不够强，而是 student 在污染上下文里丢失了原本已有的能力。matched pollution tests 显示，经过 CCOPD 后模型对 assistant-side anchors 的敏感性下降；evidence-focus probes 则表明最终答案更依赖完整用户证据，而不是 earlier assistant text。论文还报告了与 data-matched post-training baselines 的比较，CCOPD 在 Raw-Sharded 设定下更优，说明收益不是单纯来自“多看一些多轮数学数据”。摘要里没有给出参数量和训练 token 规模，正文片段也未见完整表格，因此这两项无法可靠补全。","reading_guide":"泛读建议先抓三处。第一看 效果。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper studies a specific failure mode in multi-turn interaction: a model can solve a task when all user evidence is presented in one clean A model can appear aligned at its trained parameter point, yet lose safety behavior under small weight perturbations, activation perturbations, or approximation errors introduced by compression. The authors frame this as a local-geometry problem: safety may be encoded by a sharp boundary that does not survive nearby parameter or activation changes.","importance":"The work is more relevant to post-training robustness than to pretraining itself, but it matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. Safety alignment is often a relatively small update on top of a pretrained model, and that update must survive quantization, serving-time noise, continued adaptation, and model editing. The useful point is that the base optimizer can shape the smoothness of the aligned solution. Zeroth-order optimization provides a perturbation-aware training signal, which can make the aligned behavior less tied to a single fragile point in parameter space.","technical_approach":"The proposed method is a hybrid first-order and zeroth-order refinement pipeline. The model is first aligned with a standard gradient-based optimizer, because pure zeroth-order alignment is slower and less stable. After that, a short zeroth-order refinement stage is applied. ZO estimates an update direction by evaluating the loss at randomly perturbed parameter points, controlled by a perturbation scale β. This can be interpreted as optimizing a locally smoothed objective: the model is encouraged to maintain the desired safety behavior not only at the current parameter vector, but also in its neighborhood. The paper also uses the perturbation evaluations produced by ZO to estimate layer-wise robustness sensitivity. Refinement can then be focused on layers that are more critical to safety robustness, rather than applying ZO uniformly across the entire model. The theoretical discussion relies on standard Lipschitz, smoothness, and PL-style assumptions to explain convergence and the smoothing effect.","experiments":"The experiments are organized around robustness under perturbation. First, the paper shows that aligned models can degrade under lightweight parameter noise, activation noise, and quantization-like approximation errors. Second, it compares optimization strategies and reports that pure ZO alignment is not a good replacement for FO alignment, while FO followed by a small amount of ZO refinement improves safety robustness with modest additional cost. Third, layer-wise targeted refinement uses ZO-based sensitivity estimates to concentrate updates on robustness-critical layers, improving efficiency relative to untargeted refinement.
